title: Unique Friend | Hengfang Health’s Xue Yuanxin: Customers Buy Outcomes, Not AI Concepts
summary: Inventory type remains insight (Unique Friend series — not partner welcome).
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Unique Friend Q&A · January 15, 2024 · Guest: Xue Yuanxin, PhD, Founder, Hengfang Health (横方健康)

Inventory type remains insight (Unique Friend series — not partner welcome).

Guest

Xue Yuanxin — PhD; ex-Huawei; B+ O2O founder; Hengfang Health founder. Covered by Xinhua, CCTV, People’s Daily and local TV; multiple entrepreneurship awards.

Hengfang Health — leading intelligent doctor assistant; VC-backed at founding; Huawei Pangu LLM healthcare strategic partner. Welcomed by experts at PUMCH, Sun Yat-sen, Ruijin, Renji and peers. 1M+ active patients, 1,000+ partner doctors, 25 provinces; pharma partnerships; commercial profitability.

Q&A

1. Product and core scenarios?
Public healthcare’s impossible triangle (cost–efficiency–service) is global. LLM breakthroughs open a path. Hengfang smart doctor assistant on Pangu addresses “5 hours wait, 5 minutes care” — delivering 5,000–50,000 minutes of online assist per outpatient — welcomed by patients, doctors, government, pharma; commercially live.

2. R&D / GTM; biggest 2023 challenge and win?
Product 3.0; early commercialization (1M+ patients, 1,000+ doctors, 25 provinces, pharma deals, profitability). Challenge/win: Huawei Pangu support for new iteration + successful commercialization.

3. China landing challenges?
Shell wrappers lack longevity — need deep head-firm partnerships; few true AI-native apps (mostly local efficiency patches); missing commercial closed loops — still “cost-cut” rhetoric.

4. Key product / GTM factors?
Don’t do AI for AI’s sake — customers buy benefit, not concepts. Don’t overrate AI: if AI only lifts one link in a multi-link business, overall advantage may be weak — skip hype; create real customer value.

5. Competing with giants?
Deep scene models; bind customers early and commercialize early.

6. Human–machine collaboration?
Distinguish tool-attribute (local efficiency) vs new-business-attribute (native apps) — different value.

1 CN image; attach on ingest. Signup CTA in CN omitted.

— END —
